annotations.title: Create, change or archive a reason

description:
[Reasons] Without reason_id: a new reason (decision: kind and label; position_status: label and applies_to). With reason_id: change it; fields left out keep their value; status archived stops offering it, active offers it again (an archived position status reason cannot be restored). Company-wide: a renamed reason is renamed on every past decision too. Owners only.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

applies_to.description: Position status reasons: the lifecycles it can be given for (on_hold, cancelled, closed, filled). Required for a new one; left out on a change, it stays.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

kind.description: Decision reasons: reject or withdraw. Required for a new one; it cannot change later.

label.description: The reason, 1 to 120 characters. Required for a new one; left out on a change, it stays.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional company to act on. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

reason_id.description: The reason to change (from list_reasons). Left out: a new reason is created.

sort_order.description: Position in the list (lower first). Left out: the end of the list for a new reason, unchanged otherwise.

status.description: archived: no longer offered; past decisions and lifecycle changes keep it. active: offered again (decision reasons only: an archived position status reason cannot be restored).

translations.description: Decision reasons: the label per two-letter language code, e.g. {"de": "Zu wenig Erfahrung"}. Replaces the stored translations; left out on a change, they stay.

type.description: decision (why a candidate was rejected or withdrew) or position_status (why a position went on hold, was cancelled, closed or filled).

name: save_reason
title: Create, change or archive a reason
